gui.oritech_addon_planner.title: Oritech Addon Planner
gui.oritech_addon_planner.no_machines: No Oritech machines that take addons were found.
gui.oritech_addon_planner.core_tier.tool: The tier of Machine Core you build this multiblock with. Higher tiers allow more extenders. Shift-click to go back.
gui.oritech_addon_planner.extenders.tool: The best layout for each number of extenders. Shift-click to go back.
gui.oritech_addon_planner.layered.toolti: Oritech's "layeredExtenders" setting. Off (the default) limits how many extenders count. Match what your server uses.
Look at this machine in your world and press the planner key to project the layout onto it.
gui.oritech_addon_planner.info.capacitor: Tip: Capacitor Addon Extenders work as extenders too.
gui.oritech_addon_planner.info.layered_w: Layered mode only works if your server turned it on in Oritech's config.
